title: JMSB custom mod - code review
scope: Local working copy (uncommitted work included), ~142k lines SQF in 135 addons plus extensions/jmsb_voice. Read-only. Nothing compiled or run in game.

severity.HIGH: will break, or lets any client take over the server
severity.MED: likely wrong, costly, or a trust hole

decisions.title: TFAR and ACRE out as voice options
decisions.detail: Voice is LiveKit; VON only as a whole-session fallback chosen by the server. Remove adapter_tfar, adapter_acre, the TFAR/ACRE choices in Voice system and the core's external-radio mode, radio_mesh (ACRE-only), acre_faces, compatibility/tfar_radios, tfar_cdlc_ws, tmt_tfar_labels. Trim TFAR/ACRE branches in jamming, reaction, satcom, vehicle, rf, ew, players, systems, gear, equipment, init, devices, tacpad_apps, hacking, aps, hud, map, groups. KEEP the TFAR/ACRE fields in PAC (net plan frequencies and channel labels).

fix_order: 1 Security: S1-S5, then the CfgRemoteExec whitelist (S8)
2 Will-break bugs in shared code: B6 back_to_game load order, B5 groups _unit, B7 vehicle racks, B8 projectiles on every machine
3 PAC data safety: B1, B2, B3
4 Voice before first LiveKit test: B14, B15, V1-V5

findings.problem: Admin = jmfsb_common_isAdmin, a public flag each client sets on itself. honourJmfsbAdmin is on by default and PAC's server checks use the same test. Any client can make itself admin.
findings.fix: Only the server decides who is admin (its own login check or a UID list) and sets the flag. Server checks never read a client-written flag.

findings.problem: The client edits admp_authorisedIDs and publicVariables it; the gate is a client-side BIS_fnc_admin. Any client can publish a list with its own UID. admin.reload only resets the server's copy.
findings.fix: Grant/revoke through a server event that checks the sender; only the server owns and publishes the list.

findings.problem: Compiles and runs any string with no caller check. It is a CfgFunctions function and no CfgRemoteExec whitelist was found, so any client can run code on the server.
findings.fix: Refuse unless remoteExecutedOwner is an admin (checked on the server). Add the whitelist (S8).

findings.where: adminpanel fn_createZeusModule.sqf; fn_setPlayerRank.sqf:70-72 -> players fnc_setRankOverride; fn_toggleRoleAccess.sqf:36 -> groups fnc_toggleRoleGrant
findings.problem: Server functions check isServer only, not the caller. Any client can give itself Zeus, a rank or a role.
findings.fix: Check remoteExecutedOwner is an admin in each.

findings.where: pac admin entry points (adminSet:60, adminStructure, adminOrbat, import, structureImport, csvImport, windowSet, sessionSkills:36, adminLogAdd, ticketRaise, ticketReply, applySubmit, seedFromUnit)
findings.problem: isAdmin is checked on a _caller object the client supplies; a client can pass a real admin's unit. Identity for tickets/applications and the rank in seedFromUnit are trusted. Only loadoutStore:40 checks remoteExecutedOwner.
findings.fix: Every server entry point: refuse when remoteExecutedOwner is not 0 and not owner _caller, or derive the caller from remoteExecutedOwner.

findings.where: support_air XEH_postInit:20 (order); support_fires XEH_postInit:19-20; cas XEH_postInit:22-35; evac XEH_postInit:17; artydeploy fnc_clearSpot:6; support XEH_postInit:8
findings.problem: canTask and the side check run only on the client. Any client can call fires or CAS for any side anywhere, abort others' missions, full-heal anyone.
findings.fix: Server re-checks sender side vs module side, re-runs canTask, takes the requester from the sending machine.

findings.where: hacking XEH_postInit:27-32 (deleteDrone), fnc_hackComplete -> fnc_serverPick, XEH_postInit:434-437 (deposited); messaging fnc_srvSubmit:2-15, srvRequestThread, srvClaim, srvRequestIndex; adminpanel XEH_postInit:42-48 (envTime, envWeather, stabilize); common debugRun; curator zeusAssign; respawn forceRespawnRequest; teleport fnc_zenDialog:42; patrol_base XEH_postInit:12 (dropKits), fnc_serverBuild; devices XEH_preInit:114 (uavOrder)
findings.problem: Servers act on what the client sends: delete any object, a hack result with any side/position/product, any deposit count, messages as anyone or any callsign, reading others' threads, time/weather/heal, kits and builds, UAV orders for any UAV.
findings.fix: One pattern everywhere: server checks the sender (remoteExecutedOwner), the sender's side and rights, and the target's state before acting.

findings.problem: No CfgRemoteExec whitelist in the mod. Several features send raw code with remoteExec ['call', ...] (e.g. zenmodules fnc_callEndex:50/56/100), which a whitelist would block.
findings.fix: Add a whitelist; replace remoteExec of raw code with PREP'd functions or CBA events. Missions that whitelist must list srvRoomToken, srvEchoToken, roomAnswer, echoAnswer.

findings.problem: The MongoDB connection string (password) and the LiveKit API secret are CBA server settings, which reach every client.
findings.fix: Keep both secrets in a server-only file or environment variable; settings hold only non-secret values.

findings.problem: A player joining during boot triggers a forced save of the empty preInit state to the profile before storeLoad runs. Meta is rewritten too, so the 'store lost' check misses. Roster (sync off) and in-game structure edits are lost.
findings.fix: storeSave refuses all writes until READY, or add the connect handlers after boot and pick up players already connected.

findings.problem: Stale-session close and manual-window restore run before boot has loaded the store, so they do nothing.
findings.fix: Move both into boot after storeLoad/storeAdopt.

findings.problem: Every roster publish (every join, edit, seed, ticket) makes every client re-seed, re-slot and re-apply its kept loadout. Everyone's gear resets whenever anyone joins.
findings.fix: On publish re-apply rank and skills only; seed/slot/loadout on first spawn and respawn.

findings.problem: 'One request at a time' is not enforced; concurrent loads share state and replies carry no key, so one player can be handed another's document (applyAsk). Chunked saves can interleave.
findings.fix: Server-side queue or lock, or keyed replies from the extension.

findings.problem: Runs on the server but writes YMF_oldgroup/YMF_oldrole onto player (null on dedicated; on a host it stores everyone's values on the host). PAC autoSlot relies on it, so with B3 it re-slots players repeatedly.
findings.fix: Write onto _unit.

findings.problem: Reads EGVAR(common,aceHearing) but requires only jmfsb_main, so it can be nil and the if throws.
findings.fix: Add jmfsb_common to requiredAddons.

findings.where: fnc_addRadio.sqf:34; fnc_setRadio.sqf:37 (called from init fnc_vehicle.sqf:50 and the ZEN rekit)
findings.problem: waitUntil in unscheduled code -> 'Suspending not allowed'. No vehicle gets radio racks.
findings.fix: CBA_fnc_waitUntilAndExecute, or start the setup with spawn.

findings.where: fa_antidrone fnc_initAntiDrone:90; fa_mediumcaliber fnc_initEngine:39; fa_grenade_40mm fnc_init:36; fa_ammo XEH_postInit:3
findings.problem: Fired handlers have no locality check, so every machine tracks every round: explosions, damage, ACE frag events and 40mm objects happen once per client.
findings.fix: Track only where the projectile or shooter is local, as fa_missiles XEH_postInit:21 does.

findings.problem: Reads EGVAR(adapter_alive,ready) with no default; without ALiVE the adapter is skipped and this errors. QRF never arms.
findings.fix: getVariable with a false default; log that ALiVE is absent.

findings.problem: 'getOrDefault [...] # 1' parses as getOrDefault ([...] # 1). The recovered-file pane is always blank.
findings.fix: Bracket the getOrDefault before # 1.

findings.problem: Both array elements are evaluated before select, so getDir runs on [] when no target is set. Errors every frame in the map Draw handler.
findings.fix: if/then before getDir.

findings.problem: Unticking 'Call Endex' still calls ENDEX (exitWith only leaves the inner block). Heal uses the removed ACE 3.12 function name. Hold-fire: _unit undefined, test inverted, fired args not passed - never attaches. Pacify AI runs where the groups are not local.
findings.fix: if (!_endex) exitWith; ace_medical_treatment_fnc_fullHealLocal; fix hold-fire; run AI orders on the server through events.

findings.problem: Writes to YMF_playerRanks, which nothing in the mod creates (unless a mission does). Errors on nil, no rank set.
findings.fix: Create the hashmap when nil, then publish.

findings.where: extensions/jmsb_voice session.rs:199-217, audio.rs:52; adapter_livekit fnc_callback.sqf:52, fnc_speaker
findings.problem: A new subscription removes the speaker's gain/pan; his audio re-creates him at gain 1.0. SQF cached gain 0 and never resends. Everyone is heard at full volume everywhere.
findings.fix: Keep gain/pan when a reader restarts and make new speakers silent by default; or SQF forgets its sent cache every second or two.

findings.problem: When a listener leaves a net the adapter keeps the last quality and gainOf never checks membership. He keeps hearing that net, and the next call that reuses the CALL slot.
findings.fix: gainOf requires the net in the listener's current nets, or the core sends quality 0 for keys it drops.

findings.problem: Calls ACE medical and six ACM functions unguarded; neither is in requiredAddons.
findings.fix: isNil checks or route through the acm addon.

findings.problem: emptyPositions does not drop during the loop (moveIn happens later, remotely). The whole crowd goes to the first vehicle; overflow reported as seated.
findings.fix: Keep a free-seat count per vehicle on the server.

findings.problem: UAV crew fallback puts the crew in a new group while orders go to the empty old one. Pylon weapons fired with vehicle fireAtTarget may not fire (uncertain).
findings.fix: Take group driver after crewing, delete the empty group. Test fireAtTarget; else fire through the pilot.

findings.problem: moveOut on the server only works for local units; a player in the gun is not moved before it is deleted.
findings.fix: Targeted event to crew machines, or refuse to pack while a player is in it.

findings.problem: Killed handler added on the server only; AI owned by a headless client never drops intel.
findings.fix: MPKilled, or register where local; decide on the server.

findings.problem: GVAR(enabled)=true after the settings include overrides the setting (APS can't be turned off). Server deleteVehicle on player-fired rounds may not take (unverified). Each round spawns a sleep 0.001 loop that can lag past the round's flight.
findings.fix: Delete the override line; delete on the projectile's owner like fnc_deguide; range check in the watch tick.

findings.where: init fnc_eventHandlers.sqf:5-7; systems fnc_getAttendance; init fnc_playerpost.sqf:22-24
findings.problem: Attendance runs on the admin's client but the log is server-only (always 0 on dedicated) and iterates UIDs not names. Legacy onPlayerConnected replaces the mission's handler and logs UID '' on dedicated.
findings.fix: Server event returning the result; _y get 'name'; delete the legacy handler.

findings.problem: Reads index 5 of CBA_fnc_getKeybind (likely the default key) while keyDown reads index 8. Hints show the default after a rebind (about 70% sure).
findings.fix: Check CBA's return layout; read index 8 like keyDown.

findings.problem: When messaging is missing it calls messaging's notify, which is also missing.
findings.fix: isNil guard or the notify addon.

findings.problem: ace_frag_frag_eh called with [AGL pos, typeOf]; current ACE probably expects ASL, velocity, ammo, shot parents (uncertain).
findings.fix: Check ACE source or use ACE's public frag function.

findings.problem: Uncertain: listener class stored as a string (silent if ALiVE calls it); 'get' on objectivesByID throws if ALiVE stores an array hash.
findings.fix: Check against ALiVE source (x_lib fnc_eventLog, OPCOM).

findings.problem: Uncertain: if HandleChatMessage fires on every client, server events are raised N times and local commands run everywhere.
findings.fix: Only dispatch when _sender is player; verify in game.

findings.problem: auto_subscribe is true, against the design. Every client downloads and decodes every speaker, enemy side included.
findings.fix: Off; subscribe only speakers with gain above 0.

findings.problem: Connect/disconnect race: a disconnect before the spawned connect finishes is missed; two connects leak a session and a callback task; same UID twice may loop kicks. SQF re-asks after 15 s and connects on every answer while JOINING.
findings.fix: One connect at a time (generation counter / abort handle); SQF ignores a second token answer.

findings.problem: No mic (or Windows mic privacy) fails the whole session, so he can't even listen. Retries every 10 s with a notice each time.
findings.fix: Open speakers without the mic, report the mic error once, back off.

findings.problem: The listener's own cut-off gates hearing: on EMCON 3 or unconscious he hears no radio. Under VON it only blocked talking.
findings.fix: Block hearing only when dead, or decide explicitly.

findings.problem: Game VON is not turned off; Caps Lock still reaches Arma's Push To Talk, so a mission that doesn't disable it sends voice twice.
findings.fix: Under livekit, enableChannel voice off on every game channel locally, again after respawn.

findings.problem: TerminateProcess in DllMain hides the exit crash; logs under the loader lock after threads were killed (possible hang); skips other DLLs' detach.
findings.fix: Drop the log line now; long term shut the runtime down cleanly at mission end.

findings.problem: device reopen blocks the game thread; pan resends many speakers when turning; 'speaking' parsed but unread; no token rate limit.
findings.fix: Reopen async; bigger pan epsilon or one batched call; use or drop 'speaking'; rate limit.

findings.where: voice fnc_selectSystem; adapter_von fnc_applyOpen; adapter_von fnc_audience
findings.problem: From the earlier VON review: per-machine system choice leaves a client without the DLL alone on VON; PTT 2-4 ignore the setCurrentChannel refusal; audience from the speaker's view.
findings.fix: See PLAN_VOICE_EW_PLAY.json V1, V4, V6.

findings.problem: Per net: all node pairs plus a widest-path search from every source, O(n^3) when every node relays, unscheduled on the server every 1 s. Estimated tens to 100+ ms per tick at 40 players.
findings.fix: Skip when no edge changed, a few sources per tick, relays only among relay nodes, cap group size.

findings.problem: Cache entries made in the same tick expire together, so every 5 s all pairs are rebuilt at once (thousands of ray casts in one frame).
findings.fix: Jitter lifetimes, cap rebuilds per tick, keep an entry while neither end moved.

findings.problem: One 0.05 s handler per fitted vehicle (AI too), nearObjects per family: ~1800+ calls/s for 30 vehicles.
findings.fix: One shared handler, slower when quiet, only crewed vehicles with engine on.

findings.problem: Every publish walks all sessions (never trimmed) for every player and broadcasts the full roster, summary and archive; skills re-broadcast several public vars per client. Debounced saves are never flushed.
findings.fix: Running totals on a timer; publish archive on change; set only changed vars; heartbeat flushes dirty saves.

findings.problem: Deletes and rebuilds every control each second, scans display 46, walks entities for the scanner.
findings.fix: Build once, update values, cache the scanner read.

findings.where: devices fnc_radioDraw, fnc_callWindow:13,48-49, fnc_overlayDraw/Tick; tacpad_apps fnc_appTimer:325-345, fnc_appScanner:162-178, fnc_panelTiles; tacpad fnc_readerRail ~180, fnc_composeTargets ~48
findings.problem: UI rebuilt from scratch every 0.5-2 s with no change check; the call window's r2t picture is recreated twice a second (likely flicker); reader redraws are not debounced.
findings.fix: Build controls once and update text; change keys like the tablet rows; one redraw per frame.

findings.problem: At fine settings ~160k triangle vertices redrawn every frame while the map is open.
findings.fix: Cap cells or merge into larger polygons.

findings.where: adminpanel fn_handleClientVars; hacking tabletAdvance:48; safeboating fnc_handleDamageBoat:9,17; modules fnc_moduleHealArea; ew fnc_spoof:83, fnc_publish:91
findings.problem: Broadcasts that never stop or fire far too often: every client's FPS globally 4x/s; hack progress public every second; public var on every boat HandleDamage; heal-area remoteExecs every second; AI GPS offsets public; EW slice changes almost every tick.
findings.fix: Local where only one machine reads it, coarse steps, on demand, or on change only.

findings.problem: Per-round handler with nearEntities to 2 km; bursts make dozens, multiplied by B8.
findings.fix: Fix B8 first, then an arming delay or slower tick.

findings.problem: Walks all of CfgVehicles unscheduled on every capture: a server hitch.
findings.fix: Cache infantry classes per faction once.

findings.problem: Kick/ban by name via serverCommand (needs server login, logs success regardless); headless clients seeded as players; getPlayerUID vs FUNC(uid); OPORD flag set before it posts.
findings.fix: Kick by ID and check serverCommandAvailable; skip HCs; one UID function; set the flag on confirmation.

findings.where: reaction XEH_postInit:60; qrf XEH_postInit:17, fnc_check:47-48; leaders XEH_postInit
findings.problem: Debug chat commands registered server-only, so clients on dedicated don't get them; leaders report goes to everyone; a global event with only a server handler.
findings.fix: Register on clients, gate to admins, reply to the caller; server event.

findings.where: support_fires fnc_loiterOne:52-55; drone40 fnc_deploy:44; teleport fnc_addPoint:51; evac fnc_convertAction; logistics fnc_doSupplyCrate:84-85; medbags fnc_doUnpack*, fnc_doTake:58-59; dtvd XEH_preInit
findings.problem: Empty groups left per munition; drone node lost when the launcher leaves; teleport JIP action never removed and looked up by name; two medics can run the same convert bar; ACE drag setters local only; medbags uses global flags with spawn/waitUntil and can dupe a bag; view-distance handlers added without hasInterface.
findings.fix: Small local fixes in each.

findings.where: main DisplayEden.hpp:16, script_macros.hpp:45-46; boc CfgFunctions:16,19; tacpad fnc_open ~27; devices fnc_onLoad:70-81, fnc_uavOrder:25-30, fnc_uavControl, fnc_tabletStack:35-51, fnc_overlayTick:31; tacpad_apps fnc_radioPublish:25-31
findings.problem: Wiki URL and extension names damaged by a find-and-replace ('1st Joint Multi-Functional Strike Battalion' inside them); legacy redirects to missing functions; hand-written prefix; leftover INFO logs; UAV order says done when forwarded; camera released to the man not the vehicle; reader rebuild loop on a negative height; overlay not re-placed on text scale change; player vs currentUnit.
findings.fix: Small local fixes in each.

clean: Across all nine areas every PREP has its file and every FUNC/EFUNC call resolves. RF maths is sound (no log of zero, dB/linear right, divisors guarded; two VHF handhelds reach quality 0 at ~480 m, matching the design). SQF and the Rust extension agree on command names, argument counts and callback formats. RF/EW slices use publicVariableClient on change. The ALiVE adapter is the only ALiVE caller and is skipped cleanly when ALiVE is absent. r2t camera cleanup and PFH removal are right.
not_checked: Anything in game; all performance figures are estimates from the code
ACE, ALiVE and CBA source signatures where marked uncertain (frag event, artillery tables, getKeybind index, ALiVE eventLog/objectivesByID, fireAtTarget on pylons)
PAC fnc_app.sqf and most page functions; support_air transportStep and drop code; light pass on loading, main_menu, spectator, diag, tasks, gear, systems, aceax_ammo, insurgents, documents, ambience
livekit 0.9.5 behaviour when a Room is dropped without close; nothing compiled
